items.title: Robert Hunter Named UnitedHealth (UNH) Insurance President
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (NYSE:UNH) is getting a new head of its insurance division, with executive Robert Hunter disclosing on September 28 that he will take the role. Hunter announced it himself in a post on LinkedIn, and the firm has issued no comments on the reasoning. The division he is taking over is the one […]

items.title: What Are UNH Stock Investors Betting On?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) stock trades at 22.5 times its past year's adjusted earnings, which are normalized net income with stock-based pay added back. That multiple leaves little room for error after three years of shrinking operating margins, sitting near the stock's 10-year median despite fundamentally weaker profitability. But the price looks different against the profit expected for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027. So what are UnitedHealth investors betting on.

items.title: Cigna Stock in Focus as Investor Day Spotlights Specialty Drugs
items.summary: Cigna Group investors will be looking for more detail on the growth of its specialty pharmacy business under new CEO Brian Evanko.

items.title: UnitedHealthcare names new president in latest leadership shuffle
items.summary: Robert Hunter will focus on UnitedHealthcare’s “modernization agenda” in the new role. It’s the latest in a slew of leadership changes at UnitedHealth as the company works to restore its image.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stock Has Gone Nowhere for Five Years. Its Dividend Has Not
items.summary: UnitedHealth shareholders spent five years waiting for a stock that barely budged, yet something inside the company kept growing the whole time. Whether that something is enough to make UNH worth holding now depends on costs that management has not yet fully tamed.

items.title: What to Expect From UnitedHealth’s Next Quarterly Earnings Report
items.summary: UnitedHealth will release its third-quarter earnings next month, and analysts anticipate a double-digit bottom-line growth.

items.title: 2 Healthcare Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: From novel pharmaceuticals to telemedicine, most healthcare companies are on a mission to drive better patient outcomes. Shareholders who bet on the industry have been rewarded lately as healthcare stocks have returned 46.9% over the past six months, topping the S&P 500 by 25.5 percentage points.

items.title: 67-Year-Old Costs Himself $1,315 A Year In Taxes Using A Treasury Fund To Add $1,000 A Month In Income To His Social Security And Pension. If He’d Used SCHD Instead His Tax Bill Would Be Reduced By Over 60%
items.summary: A retired man collects Social Security and a pension, adds $1,000 a month from a popular Treasury fund, and ends up handing the IRS a bill he never needed to pay. The fund type is the culprit, and the fix is hiding in plain sight.
